nhe47_md_dispatch_swap_effect = { hidden_effect_new_object = { nhe47_md_sync_then_swap_effect = yes } }

nhe47_md_dispatch_same_main_effect = {
    if = { limit = { scope:nhe47_md_a = { is_domicile_type = estate } } nhe47_md_swap_estate_kernel = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:nhe47_md_a = { nhe72_is_east_asian_estate_trigger = yes } } nhe47_md_swap_east_asian_estate_kernel = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:nhe47_md_a = { is_domicile_type = japanese_manor } } nhe47_md_swap_japanese_manor_kernel = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:nhe47_md_a = { is_domicile_type = camp } } nhe47_md_swap_camp_kernel = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:nhe47_md_a = { is_domicile_type = yurt } } nhe47_md_swap_yurt_kernel = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:nhe47_md_a = { is_domicile_type = ecclesiastical_domicile } } nhe47_md_swap_ecclesiastical_domicile_kernel = yes }
    else = { scope:actor = { trigger_event = nhe47_md.0202 } }
}

nhe47_md_own_swap_clear_effect = { remove_variable = nhe47_md_swap_title remove_variable = nhe47_md_swap_source remove_variable = nhe47_md_swap_target remove_variable = nhe47_md_swap_pending }

nhe47_md_prepare_own_swap_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { nhe47_md_selected_swap_supported = yes exists = scope:selected_title scope:selected_title = { holder = root exists = title_domicile } exists = domicile   }
        set_variable = { name = nhe47_md_swap_title value = scope:selected_title }
        set_variable = { name = nhe47_md_swap_source value = domicile }
        set_variable = { name = nhe47_md_swap_target value = scope:selected_title.title_domicile }
        set_variable = { name = nhe47_md_swap_pending value = yes }
        trigger_event = nhe47_md.0200
    }
}

nhe47_md_commit_own_swap_effect = {
    root = { save_scope_as = actor save_scope_as = recipient }
    if = {
        limit = { nhe47_md_own_pair_valid = yes }
        var:nhe47_md_swap_source = { save_scope_as = nhe47_md_a }
        var:nhe47_md_swap_target = { save_scope_as = nhe47_md_b }
        # Previous attempt status is diagnostic, never a permanent lock on an own swap.
        remove_variable = nhe47_swap_incomplete
        remove_variable = nhe47_md_swap_busy
        remove_variable = nhe47_md_core_sync_busy
        remove_variable = nhe47_md_core_sync_failed
        remove_variable = nhe47_md_swap_completed
        nhe47_md_dispatch_swap_effect = yes
    }
    else = { trigger_event = nhe47_md.0202 }
    nhe47_md_own_swap_clear_effect = yes
}
